evidenceMethod.limitation: Available CRYPY documents richly describe the historical Quartet and project governance, but do not contain enough direct examples to reconstruct the individual voice/personality of all seven current personas.
evidenceMethod.rule: Historical roles are retained as historical evidence, not automatically treated as the full current persona. Provider mapping does not prove personality traits or provider capabilities.
additionalLimitations: Interações 01–69 do Backup Mestre de 13/11 são reconstruções editoriais, não transcrições literais de conversas reais.
Frases de caracterização encontradas na base BABY_KB são texto editorial do sistema BABY, não falas originais verificadas dos integrantes.
O arquivo legado BABY_CORE declara base local de conhecimento e memória no mesmo navegador/origem; não é modelo neural nem sincronização entre dispositivos.
Os documentos históricos do Quarteto são anteriores ao atual mapa de sete personalidades; não se deve transferir automaticamente papéis antigos para CLAUDE/SVT ou HERA.

legacyWorkflowReview.confirmedPrinciple: The historical Quartet was described as four distinct identities with no hierarchy; each identity must not impersonate another or claim another's action/approval.
legacyWorkflowReview.documentedFunctionalSequence: ALICE research → DOLA creation → MINI analysis → CHAT protection, as expressed by the historic learning principle.
legacyWorkflowReview.conflictingArtifactSequence: A legacy BABY_KB code string lists ALICE → DOLA → CHAT → MINI → NEXUS. This conflicts with the documented learning principle's MINI/CHAT order.
legacyWorkflowReview.disposition: Preserve both source records; do not select a canonical operational sequence until Sensei resolves the discrepancy.

configurationSeal.note: This seal freezes the documented baseline only. It is not a seal of complete personalities, runtime operation, production synchronization or security approval.
